summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long NVTS Daily ETF (NVTX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Navitas Semiconductor stock (NASDAQ: NVTS). Navitas Semiconductor engages in the development of ultra-efficient gallium nitride (GaN) semiconductors. NVTX was launched on Sep 8, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.
